summary: Stop presenting upstream gate progress as progress of services that have not started
details: The node dashboard now leaves balance-history and usdb-indexer progress unset while those services are waiting to start, while retaining the upstream gate description.
Once a service starts, its row reports only current, total, and percentage values obtained from that service's own readiness response, avoiding an apparent progress reset at startup.

Continuous up and status --watch dashboards retain the last successful service progress for at most 60 seconds across transient readiness RPC failures, mark it STALE, and keep current lifecycle state and errors authoritative.
